purpose: This form guide relates to Form DIR-4 and the rules for maintaining a register of directors and key managerial personnel under the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Keep a register of directors and key managerial personnel at the registered office.
Include particulars such as Director Identification Number, names, parents and spouse names, date of birth, and residential address.
Include details of securities held by them in the company and related companies.
checklist: Present and former names and surnames
Date of board resolution and appointment
